name: kit-update
description: memory-kit kit-update: checks upstream for a newer release on the home's channel (memory-kit.conf update: pinned|verified|latest) and prompts the session, once per release, to run tools/kit-update.py. Never runs git, never changes files.

home.title: Kit home
home.description: The kit home whose memory-kit.conf names the channel (update:) and whose memory-kit/VERSION is current. Empty: the directory the session started in.

checkMinutes.title: Check interval (minutes)
checkMinutes.description: How often upstream's tags are asked, shared by every session through the plugin's store. At least 5.

checkUpdates.title: Check for kit releases
checkUpdates.description: Off: no request at all, whatever the channel.
